notes: The nominal MECO target lives in the OPS 1 overlay (CGGC01), where no uplink reaches: the DOLILU's VDMAG (message 96) is only the pseudo-target second-stage guidance starts from. With the tape's 25,668 ft/s PASS cut off at 25,605 truth.
VD_NOM: 25,819 ft/s, the STS-134 Ascent Checklist's MECO VI (ASC/134/FIN). The radius and flight-path angle stay the tape's (60 nmi, 0.5 deg): no STS-134 values found.

K_CMD_NOM: second stage's throttle (GG42ND step 5601, 'the rated power level setting'), 100 on the tape; STS-134 flew 104.5% to the 3-g throttling (JSC 37461 Appendix A) -- 104, the command's resolution being 1%. With 100 the simulated stack ran the second stage at 100%.

RD_NOM and FPA_NOM: a MECO about 107 km above the ellipsoid at the simulated flight's MECO latitude (37.5 deg) -- a figure quoted for STS-134 (unsourced) that agrees with the MOD FRR's 'insertion altitude 122 nm': with VI 25,819 ft/s and 0.65 deg the post-MECO apogee is about 122-125 nmi.  The tape's (111 km above the equatorial radius, ~120 km above the ellipsoid there) left a 137 x 43 nmi orbit and an OMS-2 of 292 ft/s; this one 125 x 28 and 266 ft/s (STS-134: 259.2).
